description: 消防管線懸吊系統地震破壞模式及改善措施表 [fire, police and emergency services and earthquakes] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 內政部建築研究所. Destructive mode(破壞模式)、Damage Description(破壞說明)、Mitigation measures(改善措施)、File Format(檔案格式)、Update Frequency(更新頻率)、Service Categories(服務分類). Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 內政部建築研究所. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
